migrapilot_brain.measured_by: Chat lane, production promotion gate, step 3 preflight

findings.iv_1_sideways: 🚨 The running Brain is commit f46071c3, which is NOT an ancestor of the Chat line's HEAD. It sits on release/engineer-three-track, forked from 0f494d27. Production is therefore NOT reachable from the canonical line being promoted.
findings.iv_2_identity: 🚨 The running process answers /api/version with {commit:null, release:null, buildId:null, stamped:false}. It CANNOT state its own identity. The release directory name is a label, not a stamp — and a label is exactly what IV §2 refuses to accept. Contrast the staging Brain, which answers stamped:true.
findings.iv_6_rollback: 🚨 There is NO `previous` symlink for the Brain. There is no rollback target at all, so no promotion may proceed under IV §6.
findings.per_service_freeze: There was no services.migrapilot_brain row before this one. Under the per-service freeze, absence fails closed — the Brain was never cleared to deploy.

migrapilot_brain.divergence: The production Brain and the staging Brain differ by 87 source files and ~17,127 lines. Production's is a deliberately stripped 'three qualified tracks, isolated from the mixed dev commit' build; the staging line carries search providers, the eval harness, the tool surface and the bulk of server.ts that production does not have. This is a LINE RECONCILIATION between two divergent lineages, not a routine promotion, and it was not what the IV §9 approval described.
migrapilot_brain.unattributed_change: The Brain's current symlink was re-pointed at 2026-09-19 23:22, roughly two hours before this gate ran, by work outside the Chat lane. Recorded, not accused: the Engineer lane owns release/engineer-three-track.

rules.compliance_status_scope: compliance_status MUST be attached to each deployable service, not only to the estate overall.
rules.source_vs_promotion: A service may be SOURCE_RECONCILED and still NON_COMPLIANT under IV §1-3. Reconciling source to Git does not make production map to a commit; only an immutable release deployed from that commit does. Report both, so the Control Center shows neither false extreme.
